name: Stavanger in a day
description_md:
Stavanger in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights in Norway. The day is anchored in Stavanger and features 6 sightseeing stops.

This route covers 2.1 km of walking between stops. The full day lasts about 7.2 hours, which includes visit time at each stop.
